completedTasks.title: Split Python files into smaller domain-specific modules
completedTasks.summary: Refactored scaffold.py (1455 lines) into 6 domain modules via mixin pattern: mcp_tools.py, hook_wiring.py, template_rendering.py, agent_files.py, extensions.py. scaffold.py reduced to ~600 lines. All 596 tests pass. PR #50.

completedTasks.title: MCP server declarations per stack feature
completedTasks.summary: Added mcp-servers.json per stack for declaring recommended MCP servers. Scaffold collects, merges (externalTools > stack > common), and writes to agent-specific configs: .mcp.json (Claude/Hermes/Junie), ~/.hermes/config.yaml (Hermes user-scoped), ~/.claude/settings.json (Claude user-scoped), .github/copilot/mcp-config.json (Copilot). 48 new tests, 590 total passing.

completedTasks.title: detect new stacks after initial scaffold
completedTasks.summary: Added detect_new_stacks() to drift.py. Wired into den-refresh as newStacks report field. 4 tests. Fixes gap where new stacks (e.g. hermes) were invisible to den-refresh.
